title: Independently certify #4483's finite gates (p16 2^2800000000, all four witnesses) and its arbitrary-height flow identities (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

This adds `research/rank-convergence-gates/`. It is an independent certified recomputation of zxv's #4483 (adaptive height and shifted-logarithmic majorant). That compiler is the follow-up in the maintainers' #4470 review plan; for p16 it gives sufficient rank `2^2800000000` at κ = 0.00302015.

**Claim type:** an independent certified recomputation. **No new κ.**

## Results

All four `BENCHMARKS.json` witnesses pass every finite gate, computed with my own certified interval logarithms and exponentials. The gates are the guards (18), the mirror guard (4) on every window and t-slice, the recurrence inequality (20) and the final funding (17).

| witness | D (lower) | required | final margin (lower) |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| p7 | 0.02858992 | 0.02336096 | 0.00003773 |
| native4453 | 0.05448611 | 0.04422604 | 1.19575350 |
| native4453, matched | 0.05448611 | 0.04422604 | 0.32116914 |
| **p16** | **0.04854643** | **0.04306220** | **0.60862507** |

- **Thin margins.** p7's final margin and the `τ(n₀) ≤ t_hi` covers (slack 2–7·10⁻⁸) are tight but certified. PROOF.md's p7 rejection control rejects.
- **Arbitrary-height flow (#4483's open question 1).** On raw p7, at forced heights `G = 0 … G₀+2` (including empty root classes), the exact rank-one identity (surplus 608), exits below `n`, and the exact #4459 mirror identity all hold, in 13 cases.

## Evidence

```text
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/rank-convergence-gates --check-only
  PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS (not a mathematical acceptance check)
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/rank-convergence-gates
  PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/rank-convergence-gates outcome=completed   (~7 min, stdlib only)
```

Head: `a1b836c56b4cd40cdad8ca84691e0e59e5d19a45`. Base: canonical main `f9f85c1e`.

## Not covered

- PROOF.md's theorem itself (the Chernoff and majorant arguments).
- The native suppliers and the consumer points.
